name: Copilot Fusion
summary: Pick Fusion in the Copilot model picker and it routes each coding task to the right models for you, with Standard, High, or Max effort. Works on all Copilot plans in VS Code, JetBrains, the CLI, and the Copilot app.

name: Replica
summary: Turn plain-language ideas into clickable prototypes built from your own design system's components. Free and open source under MIT, with an optional self-hosted hub for sharing prototypes and collecting comments.

name: WebAI
summary: Add AI features to websites and extensions that run on the visitor's own machine, with no API keys or per-request costs. Try the early preview free in Opera One by turning on the Web AI API in settings.

name: LFM3
summary: Run small open-weight models for text, vision, and audio on a phone or laptop, then fine-tune them on a single GPU. Download from Hugging Face in GGUF or MLX, free for commercial use under $10M revenue.

name: GPT-6.1 Terra
summary: Run coding, computer-use, and visual tasks faster with a mid-tier model priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output. Use it via the API as gpt-6.1-terra, or in Codex and ChatGPT Work on paid plans.

name: myPip
summary: Build playable games by describing an idea, then change them through conversation. Start free in your browser, with built-in multiplayer and shared editing so friends can help build and test the same game.

name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
summary: Build apps, fix bugs, and create 3D models from prompts or reference images. Use it in Kimi chat, Kimi Code, or through the API, with a faster version available on higher subscription plans.

name: Resend Inboxes
summary: Give your AI agents an email address to receive tasks, track conversations, and draft replies. Connect through an API, CLI, or MCP, with up to three free inboxes and controls over what agents can do.
